rule: Hardcoded user-visible strings per file. Counts may only go down: convert strings to catalog keys, then run node scripts/i18n-check.mjs --update. Never raise a count; every file above zero needs a reason under "reasons"; see docs/i18n.md.

reasons.src/checks.ts: Scene-authoring diagnostics: each is a VisualError with a stable code, raised while a scene is validated or evaluated (SDK and publish checks, the developer inspector). No app shows this text to people; players show the translated invalidScene message. Moving the English into the error catalog changes the released visuals bytes, so it ships with the next visuals version, not in a Core-only change.
